title: Itinerary: Chez France, Zurich and Basel
summary: After about three years in Europe, the band played Chez France, then the Singapore in Zurich and the Odeon in Basel as war loomed.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Now, how long were you over in Europe?
Let's see, '37, '38, '39... I arrived here on New Year's Day or Christmas, around Christmas or New Year's, 1940. Just three years.
All right. Well, we need to know a little bit about Europe now, and what you did there. What was the place you played at first when you went over?
Chez France, that's right. And how long did you stay
Well, we stayed there for the month of June and July...I think July... No, June. May and June.

About two months. Then we went to Zurich, the Singapore. By this time the war was breaking out. Russia had gone into Finland by this time. We played the Singapore for about a month. Then from there we went to Basel. We played the Odeon.
Basel. On the Swiss border -- Germany, France and Switzerland all together. At the time Basel was right there.
It was the German part of Switzerland.
Did you learn the languages while you were there? I suppose you must have done!
Well, I made myself understood. Everybody spoke English.
But the photographs from that time look as though you were having a pretty good time over there.
